newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 6.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 6.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Marta Tocsik was again absent from the parliament committee's hearing of the privatisation scandal.
- The same committee established that legal experts did not recommend APV Rt to use outside lawyers in its negotitaions with the municipalities.
- Socialists have asked the government to discuss tomorrow the Finance Ministry' proposal about one percent of income tax being allowed to be spent for community goals.
- The Free Democrats would like to allow that one percent to be spent on churches as well while the Socialists would prefer supplementing cultural subsidies.
- Of Hungary's exports to the European Union, 46 percent goes to Germany, while Germany has invested $4 billion in Hungary's privatisation.
